name: Summarize
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Summarize node to aggregate items together, in a manner similar to Excel pivot tables

parameters.name: Fields to Summarize
parameters.description: Use these fields to define how you want to summarize your input data
options: Average: Calculate the numeric average of your input data
Concatenate: Combine together values in your input data
Separator: Select the separator you want to insert between concatenated values
Count: Count the total number of values in your input data
Count Unique: Count the number of unique values in your input data
Max: Find the highest numeric value in your input data
Min: Find the lowest numeric value in your input data
Sum: Add together the numeric values in your input data
Field: Enter the name of the field you want to perform the aggregation on

parameters.name: Fields to Split By
parameters.description: Enter the name of the input fields that you want to split the summary by (similar to a group by statement). This allows you to get separate summaries based on values in other fields

parameters.name: Continue if Field Not Found
parameters.description: By default, if a Field to Summarize isn't in any items, the node throws an error. Use this option to continue and return a single empty item (turned on) instead or keep the default error behavior (turned off)

parameters.name: Disable Dot Notation
parameters.description: By default, n8n enables dot notation to reference child fields in the format parent.child. Use this option to disable dot notation (turned on) or to continue using dot (turned off)

parameters.name: Output Format
parameters.description: Select the format for your output format. This option is recommended if you're using Fields to Split By

parameters.name: fieldsToSplitBy
parameters.description: The name of the input fields that you want to split the summary by

parameters.name: fieldsToSplitBy
parameters.description: The name of the input fields that you want to split the summary by

options.name: continueIfFieldNotFound
options.description: Whether to continue if field to summarize can't be found in any items and return single empty item, otherwise an error would be thrown

options.name: disableDotNotation
options.description: Whether to disallow referencing child fields using `parent.child` in the field name
